summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload at install time
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs) is variable-renamed via obfuscator.io and, on every `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks it to a temporary directory, marks the binary executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the package root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style blob tagged `@bun @bun-cjs` that is never referenced by the advertised entry point `dist/index.js` (a small React `VaMfeLoader` component). The use of an alternate runtime to execute a heavily obfuscated bundled payload bypasses Node-based static inspection and runs attacker-shipped code on the installer's host at install time. The behavior is unrelated to the package's advertised React micro-frontend loader purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
